ticks.note: A -> B deferred: every transition into B is deferred, so B is entered one tick late through Deferred's _deferred_entry state.
P is suspended, but the delayed entry into B is created after Suspend and is not frozen: B's region is entered, while I's entry action (guarded by the suspend) does not run.
I is active and its entry action never runs (innerEntry stays 0).
